stageNote: Authored at spec level before scopes.md and test-plan.json exist. scopeId values name the intended scope decomposition recorded in spec.md and are subject to change when bubbles.plan authors the scopes. linkedTests, testRows and evidenceRefs are deliberately empty because no test plan has been authored; populating them now would be a fabricated linkage.
businessScenarioMapping: SCN-020-001 through SCN-020-025 map one-to-one onto BS-020-001 through BS-020-025 in spec.md. SCN-020-024 and SCN-020-025 belong to scope 4 and were added when spec.md assumption 4 was closed; they carry the next free identifiers rather than displacing any existing scenario number, so every prior identifier is stable.

scenarios.title: The finding contract is destination-agnostic and complete

gherkin.given: a topic dossier finding emitted for routing
gherkin.when: it is validated against the routable-finding contract
gherkin.then: it carries subject, claim, dated sourced evidence, horizon, originating topic identifier and dossier version, and a finding missing any required member is refused by name rather than defaulted

scenarios.title: One definition per concept

gherkin.given: the routable-finding contract
gherkin.when: the repository is inspected for its definition
gherkin.then: exactly one module defines the shape and destination-eligibility rules and every consumer reads them from that module

scenarios.title: A committed-universe subject with a real invalidation level publishes

gherkin.given: a topic finding naming an instrument in the committed universe and an invalidation carrying a direction-correct numeric price level
gherkin.when: it is routed to the brief action list
gherkin.then: it publishes with the full action contract and its evaluability resolves to machine-checkable

scenarios.title: An out-of-universe swing call is withheld and named

gherkin.given: a swing or tactical topic finding whose only instrument is outside the committed instrument universe
gherkin.when: it is routed to the brief action list
gherkin.then: it is not emitted as an action, a named exclusion records no-instrument-in-committed-universe, and the rest of the brief still publishes

scenarios.title: An unfalsifiable call cannot inflate the hit rate

gherkin.given: a swing or tactical topic finding whose invalidation carries no attributable direction-correct price level
gherkin.when: it is routed to the brief action list
gherkin.then: it is not emitted as an action and a named exclusion records the missing invalidation level

scenarios.title: Topic actions fill free slots only

gherkin.given: more qualifying topic findings than remaining slots under the configured action maximum
gherkin.when: routing selects actions
gherkin.then: the published action count does not exceed the maximum, every action present before routing is still present afterwards unchanged and in its original order, every unplaced qualifying finding is a named exclusion with a cap reason, and no topic finding is published by removing or overwriting an existing action

scenarios.title: Structural horizon is out of the evaluability rule's scope

gherkin.given: a topic finding whose horizon is structural
gherkin.when: it is routed to the brief action list
gherkin.then: the swing and tactical evaluability rule does not apply, it publishes only if it satisfies the full action contract, and it is not presented as a scored directional call

scenarios.title: A public subject with a live tool deep link publishes

gherkin.given: a topic finding inside the public watchlist scope whose deep link is a tool that filed a read this generation and whose verb is a research verb
gherkin.when: it is routed to the attention tier
gherkin.then: it publishes as an attention item

scenarios.title: RLATTN-PRIVACY is honoured, not worked around

gherkin.given: a topic finding whose subject is outside the public watchlist scope
gherkin.when: it is routed to the attention tier
gherkin.then: it is refused with the privacy code, the refusal is recorded with code, field and reason, and no substitute subject is used to force publication

scenarios.title: RLATTN-DEEPLINK is honoured

gherkin.given: a topic finding whose deep link is not among this generation's tool-read deep links
gherkin.when: it is routed to the attention tier
gherkin.then: it is refused with the deep-link code and the refusal is recorded with code, field and reason

scenarios.title: RLATTN-VERB is honoured

gherkin.given: a topic finding carrying a verb outside the research-verb vocabulary
gherkin.when: it is routed to the attention tier
gherkin.then: it is refused with the verb code and the refusal is recorded with code, field and reason

scenarios.title: RLATTN-OVERLAP is honoured

gherkin.given: a topic finding whose subject is already published in the action list this generation
gherkin.when: it is routed to the attention tier
gherkin.then: it is refused with the overlap code and the reader is not told the same thing twice

scenarios.title: Built plus excluded equals declared

gherkin.given: a generation in which topic findings were routed to the attention tier
gherkin.when: the published payload is inspected
gherkin.then: built items plus recorded exclusions equal the declared count and an empty tier is accepted rather than padded

scenarios.title: A finding whose transmission maps to a certified channel enters the alert pipeline

gherkin.given: a topic finding carrying owner evidence and a transmission that maps to a certified channel
gherkin.when: it is routed to the alert pipeline
gherkin.then: it is recorded as an anomaly seed naming its transmission channel from the existing closed channel vocabulary, and no frozen evidence bundle is required for the seed to be recorded

scenarios.title: The admission bar is applied unchanged

gherkin.given: topic-derived anomaly seeds
gherkin.when: they are clustered and built into a candidate
gherkin.then: the candidate is scored against the existing policy, a below-threshold candidate is rejected with an existing rejection reason, and no threshold is lowered because the origin is a research topic

scenarios.title: The publication gate is respected

gherkin.given: a topic-derived candidate that would clear every evidence bar
gherkin.when: the alert view is composed
gherkin.then: the projection reports the existing dependency-pending publication state, no path sets published to true, and the reader is told the qualification is local

scenarios.title: The forbidden-term vocabulary is honoured

gherkin.given: a topic finding whose text contains a term in the forbidden alarmist vocabulary
gherkin.when: it is routed to the alert pipeline
gherkin.then: it is refused with a named reason and no alarmist term reaches any published surface

scenarios.title: Nothing qualified this window

gherkin.given: no topic-derived candidate cleared the evidence bar this window
gherkin.when: the alert view is composed
gherkin.then: the empty statement is the exact committed empty-state copy and no weak candidate is promoted to avoid an empty section

scenarios.title: No exemption for research origin

gherkin.given: a published topic-originated action that later resolves
gherkin.when: the outcome ledger is updated
gherkin.then: the call appears with its outcome alongside non-topic calls and its origin does not exempt it from the hit and miss counts

scenarios.title: Origin is recorded, not privileged

gherkin.given: a published topic-originated action
gherkin.when: the ledger entry is inspected
gherkin.then: it records the originating topic identifier and dossier version and that origin changes no scoring rule, threshold or weighting

scenarios.title: A correction is a new event

gherkin.given: a published topic-originated call whose recorded outcome is later corrected
gherkin.when: the correction is applied
gherkin.then: it is a new entry referencing the original and the original entry is not edited or removed

scenarios.title: A missing capability is disclosed

gherkin.given: live Red Alert publication is unavailable and a topic-derived candidate cleared the local evidence bar
gherkin.when: the reader views the alert surface
gherkin.then: the surface states publication is dependency-pending and only local qualification is shown, and the candidate is still recorded

scenarios.title: Research is distinguishable from silence

gherkin.given: a topic finding refused by every destination
gherkin.when: the generation completes
gherkin.then: the operator can see the finding existed and which gate refused it, the reasons carry each refusing gate's own code, and the finding is not silently discarded

scenarios.title: An unmappable transmission is a named outcome, not a forced fit

gherkin.given: a topic finding whose transmission matches none of the certified channels
gherkin.when: it is routed to the alert pipeline
gherkin.then: no anomaly seed is emitted, the outcome is recorded by name as a finding with no certified transmission channel, the closed channel vocabulary is not extended and no channel is approximated to admit it, and its eligibility for the action list and the attention tier is unaffected

scenarios.title: Seeding and candidacy have different preconditions, stated honestly

gherkin.given: a topic-derived anomaly seed whose evidence did not come through the committed acquisition path
gherkin.when: candidate assembly is attempted
gherkin.then: no candidate is assembled, the seed remains recorded rather than discarded, the outcome is recorded by name as a missing frozen evidence bundle, and no bundle is substituted or synthesised to promote it
